The perceptual quality auditor's finding of 'slight compression' is likely misinterpreting AI-generated noise/smoothing as JPEG artifacts.

The failure to render legible text on the license plate and the ambiguous anatomy of the passengers (confirmed by high pose uncertainty) reduces the alignment score from a perfect 5. The vehicle structure itself is coherent, but the human subjects and textual details show significant AI deviations.
